title: Book Three · Chapter 113: The Last Shared Line
story:
Two weeks after Ronan sends the seventeenth letter, Leo's reply arrives on Monday.

His grandmother has written to him. She has the twenty and a half yuan, five books, and one cloth bag in her cupboard for him.

Leo has read the final account. He agrees with the split and the waste paper. His own copy now has the same last line as Ronan's.

No shared cash or stock remains.

Then he writes about school. His friend has begun to throw straighter. Leo says that may make the next holiday game much harder.

Ronan laughs at the little warning.

He lays the reply beside the account sheet. Mrs Deng's refund is there, with the date. The two damaged books and the old card are marked as waste paper, with no money received.

The ten good books are divided five and five. Both bags are divided too. The forty-one yuan went into two equal shares of twenty and a half.

Ronan writes Leo's agreement beside the last line. Both know the result now. All the known returns are finished.

Mum comes to the table with a short piece of lining.

“Done?” she asks.

“The sale.”

She looks at the school book beside his papers.

“Not that part.”

He smiles. “No.”

Ronan puts the account with Leo's letter. His own five books stay on his shelf. The cloth bag beside them is his now, not a place for joint stock.

That evening, Dad asks about the final count. Ronan gives the amounts and tells him about the books.

“More than money,” Dad says.

“More work than I expected too.”

Dad nods. Then he asks about school, and the talk moves to the next day's lesson.

After dinner, Ronan opens one of his five stories for a few minutes. There is a pencil mark beside a picture. He remembers the first customer and her green animal book.

He reads two pages, then puts the story down. Tomorrow's work still needs the desk.

At school the next morning, Anna asks if he has finished the hard question.

“Almost.”

“That means one more line?”

“It means the teacher may need to help.”

She laughs and opens her own page. Lin comes to the door to call her for a later run. They arrange the time before the lesson starts.

Ronan finds his pencil. The blue cord is still around his wrist. At the next desk, Kai is looking for a ruler under a pile of books.

Ronan slides his spare ruler across. Kai takes it with a grin, and both turn toward the board as the teacher comes in.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

final account＝最后的账目；split＝分配结果；remain＝剩下；spare ruler＝备用尺子。

## 理解问题

1. Leo是否真实收到祖母和Ronan的消息并确认最终分配？共同财物现在还剩多少？
2. 各自得到的是什么？这是否表示他们只有现金多出的半元、没有书和袋子？

## 读句子

**All the known returns are finished.**

拆开看：All the known returns / are / finished.

目前已知的所有退货事项／都已经／处理完了。
